message.content: {"caption":"Three-panel comparison of memory-management approaches for an LLM agent, contrasting separate short- and long-term memory systems with a unified agentic framework.","description":"The diagram follows a query and session content through three frameworks. In (a), static short-term memory is paired with trigger-based long-term memory, whose storage operations are shown separately. In (b), a memory manager handles long-term-memory operations while short-term memory remains static. In (c), the proposed AgeMem framework uses an agentic manager and short- and long-term memory tools to jointly manage both memory types. Each panel also shows context or memory feeding into an LLM answer.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
